titleEn: Gentle with the Baby, Like a Feather!

pages.text: "Baby, I will carry you!" Lulu offered a back to the baby cousin. On the kitchen floor, the baby kicked little feet and looked up at Lulu.
Lulu gripped the baby's arm tightly and pulled hard. "Heave-ho! I am strong!" The baby winced.
"Waaah!" The baby cried. Lulu pulled both forepaws to the chest and stepped back. "Why? I was trying to give you a ride..."
Mom picked the baby up first to soothe the tears. "The baby is still small. Your hands are big and strong." She gently laid her hand on Lulu's palm.
She stroked the back of Lulu's hand with a white feather. Tickly! "Only this much strength. Gentle with the baby, like a feather!"
Lulu looked around the floor. A hard wooden spoon and olives lay there. Lulu put them in a box on a low shelf.
Lulu sat low on the floor, lowering the back. Mom gently set the baby there, like a feather. Lulu turned the bell behind the neck. It jingled before the baby's face. Laughter!
Mom supported Lulu's back with a hand. Lulu swayed gently. Jingle, jingle! The baby rested a cheek against the back. "No hurting, right? I will be very gentle."
The baby reached a forepaw for bread. Lulu gently set it in the little hand. "One, hold gently! Two, put hard things away! Three, baby first!"
Mom touched her forehead to Lulu's. Gentle as a feather, and the baby snuggles close. Lulu touched a nose to the baby's cheek and whispered, "Gentle with the baby, like a feather!"
